---
title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Extract the 67 county precinct files to a temporary folder and read them in
files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())
raw_results <- read_tsv(files, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE, quote = "")

# Filter to the Republican primary for Governor and calculate vote totals and shares
gov_rep <- raw_results |>
  filter(X12 == "Governor", X16 == "REP") |>
  summarize(votes = sum(as.numeric(X19), na.rm = TRUE), .by = X15) |>
  rename(candidate = X15) |>
  mutate(
    pct = votes / sum(votes),
    # Format a label showing both vote count and percentage share
    label = paste0(scales::comma(votes), " (", scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")")
  )

# Plot total votes by candidate with colors and data labels
gov_rep |>
  ggplot(aes(x = votes, y = fct_reorder(candidate, votes), fill = fct_reorder(candidate, votes))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.05, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", direction = -1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_comma(),
    # Expand the right side of the x-axis so the text labels fit
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Statewide official results (Total votes: ",
      scales::comma(sum(gov_rep$votes)),
      " across all 67 counties)"
    ),
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State (08/18/2026 Primary Election)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 13
#| fig-width: 9

# Summarize total Republican primary votes for Governor by county (column X2)
county_votes <- raw_results |>
  filter(X12 == "Governor", X16 == "REP") |>
  summarize(votes = sum(as.numeric(X19), na.rm = TRUE), .by = X2) |>
  rename(county = X2) |>
  mutate(
    pct = votes / sum(votes),
    label = paste0(scales::comma(votes), " (", scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")")
  )

# Plot total votes for all 67 Florida counties
county_votes |>
  ggplot(aes(x = votes, y = fct_reorder(county, votes), fill = fct_reorder(county, votes))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.05, size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", direction = -1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Republican Primary Votes for Governor by County",
    subtitle = "All 67 Florida counties ordered from highest to lowest total votes",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State (08/18/2026 Primary Election)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```
